verdict.rationale: Sentry's Issues page is where developers see and debug errors affecting their application, with filters for unhandled errors and impacted users. Stack traces and suspect commits are documented, and the CLI handles release and source-map management, so the core of the story is delivered. missing for 10: explicit evidence of regression detection (e.g., resolved issues reopening on a new release), detailed documentation of release tracking and health beyond the CLI mention, and an explicit description of how errors are grouped into issues, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
